findings: Definition1 fixes label-dependent token ordering through a fixed linear head. Lemma2 uses strict decreasing scalar loss and separability of selected optimal tokens.
Theorem2 assumes unique optimal indices and feasible tokenSVM; its stated Frobenius/nuclear conclusions concern regularization paths.
B.2 first bounds any convex token mixture by the fixed best-token score. Its attainability step explicitly sends a separating softmax score scale to infinity so its mass tends to that token.
source_transfer_limits: The native40class coadapted head does not fix those scalar token scores. Its Born probabilities are bounded and have epsilon1e-6 floor.
Actual AdamW/decoupled decay/clip/finitevalidselection is not the stated regularization path or plainGD. No source-equivalent nuclear-norm/implicit-bias theorem is supplied.
The2024extension discussion does not prove joint training remains an open problem in2026. No exhaustive forward-citation review was conducted.
No full58page deep-reading claim or audit of allGD/convergence proofs.
